panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard (added in the homelab).

options.content:
Example dashboard shipped by the Argo Rollouts project (`examples/dashboard.json`, tag **v1.10.2** = installed
version). Top rows: controller and Rollouts by phase; bottom row: one Rollout chosen with the variables.
**Today no Rollout exists**, so everything except *Uptime* and *Memory Used* is empty by design. Adapted: the
Rollout's namespace is `exported_namespace` here (the scrape sets `namespace=argo-rollouts`), so the variable
and filters use it. Legacy `singlestat`/`graph` panels are auto-migrated by Grafana. Curated view with
AnalysisRuns, workqueues and API calls: **Argo Rollouts / Operations**.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: Uptime (controller)
panels.description: Time since the controller process started (`process_start_time_seconds`). A small value = recent restart. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Total Rollouts
panels.description: Rollout objects known to the controller (`rollout_info`). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Rollouts
panels.description: Rollouts per strategy (canary / blueGreen). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Stable
panels.description: Rollouts in phase Completed (fully promoted, healthy). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Progressing
panels.description: Rollouts shifting traffic or scaling a new ReplicaSet. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Paused
panels.description: Rollouts waiting at a pause step. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Error
panels.description: Rollouts in phase Error (ReplicaSet creation failed). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Invalid Spec
panels.description: Rollouts whose spec is invalid (InvalidSpec condition). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Timeout
panels.description: Rollouts that exceeded progressDeadlineSeconds. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Aborted
panels.description: Rollouts aborted (failed analysis or manual abort); traffic is back on the stable version. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Reconcile Activity
panels.description: Rollout reconciliations in the last 10 minutes (`rollout_reconcile_count`). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Reconciliation Performance
panels.description: Distribution of Rollout reconcile durations (`rollout_reconcile_bucket`). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Memory Used
panels.description: Controller Go heap in use (`go_memstats_heap_alloc_bytes`). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Phase
panels.description: Labels of `rollout_info` for the selected Rollout (strategy, traffic router, phase). Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Replicas (desired)
panels.description: Desired replicas of the selected Rollout. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Replica (available)
panels.description: Available replicas of the selected Rollout. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

panels.title: Replica (unavailable)
panels.description: Unavailable replicas of the selected Rollout. Upstream panel, query unchanged (source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json).

title: Argo Rollouts / Official
description: Example dashboard of the Argo Rollouts project (https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json), pinned to the installed version v1.10.2 and adapted: rollout namespace variable/filters on exported_namespace, fixed datasource, homelab annotations, reading guide, descriptions.
